description: Terna's main planned transmission projects for the grid map (etl/fetch_grid.py copies this file to app/data/grid/plans.json). Curated by hand from Terna's Development Plan 2025 (PdS 2025, Overview pp. 39-43: projects and in-service years) and its progress report of 28 February 2026 (RdA 2026: phases at 31 December 2025, Table 13: works due in service 2026-2028). Stations at their OpenStreetMap positions; foreign ends, landfalls and sea routes drawn by the author (route: schematic). year: the last in-service year Terna gives (2035 for 'after 2034'); phase: only where Terna states it. Update after each new Development Plan (every two years, next PdS 2027) and progress report (every February).

sources.rda2026: Terna, Rapporto di avanzamento del Piano di Sviluppo 2025 (28 February 2026)

projects.name: Tyrrhenian Link, East Link
projects.description: Submarine HVDC link between Campania (Eboli converter, Montecorvino station) and Sicily (Caracoli, Termini Imerese); with the West Link it ties Sicily and Sardinia to the mainland.

projects.name: Tyrrhenian Link, West Link
projects.description: Submarine HVDC link between Sicily (Caracoli, Termini Imerese) and Sardinia (Selargius, whose new station entered service in July 2025).

projects.name: Adriatic Link (HVDC Centre-South - Centre-North)
projects.description: HVDC link, mostly submarine, between the Villanova (Abruzzo) and Fano (Marche) stations, to raise the transfer capacity between the Centre-South and Centre-North zones. Authorised in January 2024; moved to construction in 2025.

projects.name: SA.CO.I.3 (Sardinia - Corsica - Italy)
projects.description: Renewal and upgrade of the HVDC link between Tuscany (Suvereto) and Sardinia (Codrongianos) through Corsica, which replaces SA.CO.I.2 at the end of its life. Authorised in September 2023.

projects.name: ELMED (Italy - Tunisia)
projects.description: New HVDC interconnection between Sicily (Partanna) and Tunisia (Cap Bon), among the interconnections Terna lists as under construction or authorised.

projects.name: 380 kV Bolano - Annunziata
projects.description: New 380 kV submarine cable across the Strait of Messina between Calabria (Bolano) and Sicily (Annunziata, formerly Paradiso), for the renewables expected in Sicily and the South. Authorised in September 2024; the cable is due in 2027, the works on the Sicilian side in 2026-2028.

projects.name: 380 kV Colunga - Calenzano
projects.description: New 380 kV line across the Apennines between Emilia-Romagna (Colunga) and Tuscany (Calenzano) through the new San Benedetto del Querceto station, raising the North - Centre-North transfer capacity.

projects.name: 380 kV Foggia - Larino - Gissi
projects.description: New 380 kV connection along the Adriatic between Puglia (Foggia), Molise (Larino) and Abruzzo (Gissi), raising the transfer capacity between the zones.

projects.name: 380 kV Montecorvino - Avellino Nord - Benevento
projects.description: New 380 kV line in Campania between the Montecorvino and Benevento stations, through the Avellino Nord 380 kV station.

projects.name: 380 kV Chiaramonte Gulfi - Ciminna
projects.description: New double-circuit 380 kV line across Sicily between the Chiaramonte Gulfi and Ciminna stations, with the Ciminna 380 kV extension (2026-2028).

projects.name: 380 kV Laino - Altomonte (north Calabria)
projects.description: New 380 kV line between the Laino and Altomonte stations, the main work of the north Calabria grid rearrangement (the rest due by 2036). Authorised in August 2025.

projects.name: 380 kV Cassano - Chiari
projects.description: 380 kV line between the Cassano and Chiari stations, part of the 380 kV connection between Milan and Brescia.

projects.name: Vizzini 380/150 kV station
projects.description: New 380/150 kV station at Vizzini (formerly Mineo station) in Sicily, with its 380 kV and 150 kV connections.

projects.name: Volpago 380/220/132 kV station
projects.description: New 380/220/132 kV station at Volpago del Montello (Veneto). Authorised in November 2025. Position: the municipality.

projects.name: Hypergrid HG-1: HVDC Milano - Montalto
projects.description: HVDC link from Lazio (Montalto) to Lombardy through Liguria: a submarine HVDC section and existing AC backbones reused. Terna has not published the route: the landfall in Liguria and the line to Milan are drawn only to show the link.

projects.name: Hypergrid HG-2: Central Link
projects.description: Rebuild of the 220 kV line between Villavalle (Umbria) and S. Barbara (Tuscany) on low-field "5 phases" towers. Authorisation started in October 2025.

projects.name: Hypergrid HG-3: SAPEI 2 (Fiumesanto - Montalto)
projects.description: New submarine HVDC link between Sardinia (Fiumesanto) and Lazio (Montalto), part of the Sardinian backbone. Drawn along the existing SAPEI cable as far as the open sea.

projects.name: Hypergrid HG-3: Sardinian Link
projects.description: Rebuild of Sardinia's inland 220 kV backbone between Codrongianos, Oristano, Sulcis, Villasor and Selargius on low-field "5 phases" towers. Authorisation started in October 2025.

projects.name: Hypergrid HG-4: Ionian-Tyrrhenian backbone (Priolo - Rossano - Latina)
projects.description: HVDC link from Sicily (Priolo) to Lazio (Latina) through a new converter at Rossano (Calabria): submarine Priolo - Rossano, the AC lines Rossano - Laino (380 kV) and Laino - Tusciano (220 kV) rebuilt for up to ±525 kV DC, and submarine from near Montecorvino to Latina.

projects.name: Hypergrid HG-5: Adriatic backbone (Foggia - Forlì)
projects.description: A single HVDC link of up to ±525 kV between the Foggia and Forlì nodes, strengthening the Adriatic corridor. Terna has not published the route.

projects.name: GRITA 2 (Italy - Greece)
projects.description: Second HVDC interconnection with Greece; in authorisation or consultation. Terna has not published the route: drawn beside the existing GRITA cable from Galatina.

projects.name: Italy - Montenegro, second pole
projects.description: Second pole of the HVDC interconnection with Montenegro (MON.ITA), among the interconnections Terna lists as under construction or authorised; Terna makes its development conditional and gives no date. Drawn beside the existing cable.

projects.name: 220 kV Italy - Austria (Soverzene - Lienz)
projects.description: Rebuild of the existing 220 kV Soverzene - Lienz line, with new equipment to control the power flows; in authorisation or consultation.

projects.name: HV interconnection Dobbiaco - Austria
projects.description: High-voltage interconnection from Dobbiaco (South Tyrol) to Austria, under study.

projects.name: Italy - Switzerland interconnection and Valchiavenna rationalisation
projects.description: More transfer capacity towards Switzerland, ahead of a wider rationalisation of the grid in Valchiavenna; in authorisation or consultation. No route published: shown at the Mese station.

projects.name: 380 kV Aliano - Montecorvino
projects.description: New 380 kV line between Basilicata (Aliano) and Campania (Montecorvino). Aliano at its municipality.
